## Clockwork Overseer (CR 2)

**XP 600  
** N Small construct  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +1  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 30 (2d10+10)  
 **Fort** +0; **Ref** +1; **Will** +1  
 **Immune** construct traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** slam +5 (1d6+2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 12, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 15  
 **SQ** independent clockwork  

**Special Abilities**

 **Independent Clockwork (Su)** An overseer can move beyond the brain gear’s normal area of influence while maintaining contact with it. Normally, a brain gear can control only clockworks that are within two miles of its position. A brain gear can control an overseer that stays within 10 miles of its position. In addition, the overseer can act as a field commander for up to 20 HD worth of clockworks that are within 100 feet of its position. These clockworks are considered to be in contact with the brain gear so long as the overseer is in contact with it.
